title.en: Query backup time and backup ID

descriptions.zh: > 该接口返回的备份时间是开始执行备份任务的时间，因备份任务执行需要一定的时间，并不代表备份内容正好是备份时间的快照。
descriptions.en: > The backup time returned by this API is the time when the backup job started. Because task execution takes some time, this time does not represent an exact snapshot of the backup content at that moment.
